==categorization of chapter summaries==
Pages will not be added or removed to category pages via templates until each page that uses such a template is edited or moved.  You can probably force this by loading each chapter summary page with ?action=purge appended to the URL.

However, I am not sure categories for chapter summaries will be useful now that we have chapter index infoboxes everywhere... and even if they were useful your naming scheme is uncomfortably verbose.  I would go with something like "Category:TEotW summaries", if anything... but also note how [[ConcordWiki:Category:Wheel_of_Time_chapters]] does it. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 06:07, 28 Dec 2005 (UTC)
